create or ALTER  view  che_map
as
select cheID, CHE_Name
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'silver/ecevents',
        data_source = 'dgt',
        FORMAT = 'DELTA'
    ) AS [che_map]
    GROUP by cheID, CHE_Name;

create or alter view sc_prod_wo_pool
as
select *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'gold/sc_prod',
        data_source = 'dgt',
        FORMAT = 'DELTA'
    ) AS [sc_prod_wo_pool];

create view sc_prod
as
(
SELECT sp.*, sc_map.CHE_Name, sc_map.Pool from dbo.sc_prod_wo_pool sp
LEFT JOIN 
(SELECT cheID, CHE_Name, MAX(Pool) as Pool
 FROM [dbo].[sc_info] sc
  INNER join dbo.che_map ch
  on LOWER(sc.Handler_id) = LOWER(ch.CHE_Name) 
  group by Handler_id, cheID, CHE_Name) sc_map
    on sp.CHE_Id = sc_map.cheID
)

create or alter view sc_productivity_wo_pool
as
select *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'gold/sc_productivity',
        data_source = 'dgt',
        FORMAT = 'DELTA'
    ) AS [sc_productivity_wo_pool];

create view sc_productivity
as
(
SELECT sp.*, sc_map.CHE_Name, sc_map.Pool from dbo.sc_productivity_wo_pool sp
LEFT JOIN 
(SELECT cheID, CHE_Name, MAX(Pool) as Pool
 FROM [dbo].[sc_info] sc
  INNER join dbo.che_map ch
  on LOWER(sc.Handler_id) = LOWER(ch.CHE_Name) 
  group by Handler_id, cheID, CHE_Name) sc_map
    on sp.CHE_Id = sc_map.cheID
)
